entry.summary: RT Pix🔎 Xyzeva just saved crypto. Again. She found a flaw that could’ve hacked Coinbase engineers and top crypto teams through a massive auto-update exploit. Millions of users were at risk. Billions in assets on the line. She reported it. It got patched. Crypto was saved. Her reward? Just $55K. But this isn’t even her first time. She also exposed a16z leaking AWS keys, database credentials, and PII—sitting in inspect element. That hack could’ve compromised one of the biggest VCs in crypto. Her reward? $0. Then, she discovered a way to hijack someone’s Arc browser without them even visiting a website — letting attackers execute arbitrary JavaScript on any page. That time, she got $2K. $57K total for stopping multiple disasters. Some people break crypto. Xyzeva keeps saving it.

entry.summary:
RT arctotherium Immigration and fertility are the two things I most write about, so this article was probably inevitable. The thrust of it: "we need immigration because of low birth rates" is not only wrong but actively counterproductive; immigration makes the problems of population decline worse, not better. It barely budges population aging, lowers living standards, makes paying pensions harder, not easier, weakens national unity and thus national strength, and erases ethnic groups rather than ensure their continuance. Read it below.
Noah Carl: "Once you start looking at the reasons why a growing population might be beneficial, it becomes clear that actually-existing immigration makes the problems of population decline worse, not better." https://www.aporiamagazine.com/p/immigration-does-not-solve-population
